author: athmanecharif
quote: I think Rockstar's real game wasn't GTA 6; it was buying off 150 reviewers and building a media cartel that hands out perfect scores without hesitation to push us into buying it, and unfortunately, I fell for it. Meanwhile, with this box and a code sitting in my hands, I still can't process it—the reviewers failed me. The gaming community deserves a better review platform with a seal of honesty and quality.

author: athmanecharif
quote:
Coming from another platform, this is my very first Nintendo and Zelda game. Long story short, gameplay and its soundtrack stand out, Its only flaw is its short length. sweet and rich, for me it deserves game of the year hands down! The soundtrack is incredible.
Edit (One week later): I need to eat my words. After spending a few more days with it, my initial 'it's just short and sweet' review is no longer enough. This isn't just a great game anymore—it easily surpassed every single game I have ever played in my entire life. Crown it.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
